title: RelatedList object columns: spec-canonical `field` spelling passes every RelatedList read, then renders header + blank cells at the data-table accessor
body:
Found while implementing objectstack#9227 (strict element schemas for `Field.inlineColumns` / `Field.relatedListColumns`). Out of that card's scope — filed, not fixed. Measured against objectui `main` (34ae327), 2026-08-17.

## What

A `relatedListColumns` OBJECT entry keyed with the list-surface canonical `field` spelling splits between two vocabularies on its way to the screen:

- `packages/plugin-detail/src/RelatedList.tsx` resolves column identity as `c.accessorKey || columnIdentity(c)` — and `columnIdentity` (`packages/core/src/utils/column-identity.ts`) is canonical-first on `field`. So a `{ field: 'status', label: 'Status' }` entry passes the FLS filter, the FK filter, `pruneEmpty`, the sort-button row, and even gets a type-aware `cell` attached by `normalizeColumn`.
- The `data-table` renderer it feeds (`packages/components/src/renderers/complex/data-table.tsx`) normalizes the accessor as `accessorKey: col.accessorKey || col.name` — it never consults `field` (or `columnIdentity`). The accessor resolves to `undefined`, every cell reads `row[undefined]`, and the attached cell renderer receives `undefined` — rendering the em-dash placeholder.

Net effect: the column survives every metadata-aware filter and renders a header with blank cells — the exact objectui#3951 failure shape, one spelling over. The only object spelling that works end to end today is the legacy `name` key, which `column-identity.ts` itself documents as "objectui-side legacy" for list surfaces.

## Why it matters

`column-identity.ts` says `field` is THE contract for list columns (`ListColumnSchema`), and objectui#3104 converged 22 read sites onto `columnIdentity()` — but the data-table's accessor normalization predates that convergence and was never folded in. Any host metadata or page schema that authors related-list column objects in the spec-canonical spelling gets the silent blank-cell failure.

Note: objectstack#9227 narrowed the spec's `Field.relatedListColumns` to field-name STRINGS (which `normalizeColumn` hydrates fully), so the framework's authoring surface no longer reaches this seam — but `RelatedList.columns` is also fed by page schemas (`record:related_list.columns`) and any host passing objects directly, so the seam is still live for objectui's own consumers.

## Reproduce

Render `RelatedList` (type `table`) with `columns={[{ field: 'status', label: 'Status' }]}` and rows that have `status` values: the Status header renders, every cell shows the empty placeholder, and the sort button row happily sorts by `status`.

## Suggested direction (for triage, not a decision)

Either fold `columnIdentity()` into the data-table's accessor normalization (`accessorKey: col.accessorKey || columnIdentity(col)`), or have `RelatedList.normalizeColumn` write the resolved identity into `accessorKey` before handing object entries to the table — the latter keeps the two vocabularies from merging inside the table library adapter, which is the boundary `column-identity.ts` deliberately drew (`TABLE_ADAPTER_COLUMN_KEY`).
